What can be recorded is therefore limited to the search tool's summary of those SIBLING Silver Oak pages: the most frequently cited use is buying before selling, with the borrower's existing property securing the loan and the sale proceeds repaying it; investors use bridging when they need funds quickly for a time-sensitive opportunity; developers use bridging to cover refurbishment or construction and repay through a sale or by refinancing onto a longer-term facility; the main /bridging-loans-uk/ page lists purchases, renovations and covering a short-term cash flow gap as typical reasons.
